授業概要
半導体、磁性体、誘電体等の電子材料の電子物性、およびこれらを用いた電子デバイスの動作原理、作製法、評価法に関する研究分野において、具体的な研究テーマを設定するとともに、当該テーマに関係する学術論文の精読、調査を行い、これらを踏まえて研究を遂行して、博士学位論文を執筆する。（*グローバルコースでも開講）
Students are required to set a specific research theme in the research field of electronic properties of electronic materials such as semiconductors, magnetic materials, and dielectrics, as well as operating principles, fabrication methods, and evaluation methods of electronic devices using these materials. In addition, students are required to conduct a careful reading and investigation of academic papers related to the theme in question, carry out research based on these, and write a doctoral thesis.（*This lecture is also available for Global Course. ）
